command:
set -u; echo '=== identity/time ==='; hostname; whoami; date -Is; echo '=== load/memory ==='; uptime; free -h; echo '=== relevant user services ==='; systemctl --user --no-pager --plain status frankenstein-local-bridge.service clay-local-bridge.service 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p'; echo '=== relevant processes ==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,%cpu,%mem,etime,cmd --sort=-%cpu | grep -E 'harness_aider|chatgpt|chrome|chromium|playwright|local_bridge|frank' | grep -v grep | head -80; echo '=== star candidate files ==='; find /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*chatgpt*' -o -iname '*harness*' -o -iname '*bridge*' \) -printf '%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %s %p
' 2>/dev/null | sort -r | head -120; echo '=== recent bridge/harness logs, names only ==='; find /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*.log' -o -iname '*receipt*' \) -printf '%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %s %p
' 2>/dev/null | sort -r | head -80
